prompt: Generate ONE opaque seamless top-down texture of the TOP SURFACE of a wall made of sun-dried ochre mud bricks in the Neolithic. Portrait tall image fully filled. Viewed exactly from above, NOT the wall's vertical face. Each rectangular brick is long vertically (NORTH-SOUTH); all long brick axes point from TOP to BOTTOM of the image, arranged as two or three narrow columns, offset vertically. The wall RUN is north-south. Bricks are about three times as long top-to-bottom as they are wide. No horizontal long bricks. Full-bleed material to all edges, no white margins. Seamless top/bottom: matching column colors and courses at both ends. Upper-left local lighting remains upper-left, not rotated with bricks. Restrained dark-brown ink and warm earthy ochre watercolor broad forms, straw specks sparse. No ground, borders, wallsides, text or perspective.
seam_applicability: Repeat axes only; isolated end/junction/door do not tile.
projection_applicability: Standing doors only; wall components/top/floor do not have a standing silhouette.
